title: GCP-5.3 backbone DAO route propagation unwired: tested bridge library has zero production callers, no per-destination admission parity, no withdrawal
description: spec/08-gateway-coordination.md GCP-5.3 (L126-135), three MUSTs (R-08-015/016/017, sweep 2026-09-09): (1) L126 'Gateways MUST aggregate reachable destinations and propagate them across the backbone so that any gateway can forward to any node'; (2) L130 'a gateway MUST NOT import backbone routes for destinations that fail the same signature and admission gates it applies to local nodes'; (3) L133 'a gateway MUST withdraw a destination's backbone route when the corresponding node disassociates or its DAO lifetime expires'. Evidence: DaoBackboneBridge library exists and is unit-tested in Rust (rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:569-779; tests/multi_instance_vectors.rs:212-501) and Python (python/src/lichen/rpl/multi_instance.py:346-611; tests/rpl/test_multi_instance.py:310-611) and in C (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_multi_instance.c:338-430, NO test) — but queue_for_propagation/receive_from_peer have ZERO production callers in lichen-gateway/lichend/apps; imported routes are checked only for instance/self/freshness/origin-identity/count-caps (rust :684-757), NOT per-destination signature/admission parity with local-node admission; withdrawal: rust clear_received_routes :775 is manual only, no TTL/lifetime eviction in any stack; local-route withdrawal (python dao_manager.py:1004-1012) does not cover the backbone-visible route set. Suggested placement: wire bridge into gateway runtime (rust/lichen-gateway + bin/lichend.rs; C lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl + lichen/apps/gateway; python gateway runtime), add per-destination admission gate mirroring local admission, add lifetime sweeper for received backbone routes. Note custody/best-effort decision (custody-best-effort) does not relax these MUSTs — they define conforming custodian/gateway behavior.
